description: Test utility code for HTTP/2 frame matching using Google Mock, defining custom matchers for nghttp2 frames and headers.

classes.name: FrameHeaderMatcher
classes.description: Custom matcher for nghttp2 frame headers, matching stream ID, type, and flags.

classes.name: PointerToFrameHeaderMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for pointer to nghttp2 frame header, delegates to FrameHeaderMatcher.

classes.name: ReferenceToFrameHeaderMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for reference to nghttp2 frame header, delegates to FrameHeaderMatcher.

classes.name: DataMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for nghttp2 data frames, checking stream ID, length, flags, and padding.

classes.name: HeadersMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for nghttp2 headers frames, checking stream ID, flags, and category.

classes.name: RstStreamMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for RST_STREAM frames, checking stream ID and error code.

classes.name: SettingsMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for SETTINGS frames, matching a vector of Http2Setting.

classes.name: PingMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for PING frames, checking opaque data and ACK flag.

classes.name: GoAwayMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for GOAWAY frames, checking last stream ID, error code, and opaque data.

classes.name: WindowUpdateMatcher
classes.description: Matcher for WINDOW_UPDATE frames, checking window size increment.

methods.name: HasFrameHeader
methods.description: Creates a matcher for nghttp2 frame header with specific stream ID, type, and flags.

methods.name: HasFrameHeaderRef
methods.description: Creates a matcher for reference to nghttp2 frame header with specific stream ID, type, and flags.

methods.name: IsData
methods.description: Creates a matcher for nghttp2 data frames with specified stream ID, length, flags, and padding.

methods.name: IsHeaders
methods.description: Creates a matcher for nghttp2 headers frames with specified stream ID, flags, and category.

methods.name: IsRstStream
methods.description: Creates a matcher for RST_STREAM frames with specified stream ID and error code.

methods.name: IsSettings
methods.description: Creates a matcher for SETTINGS frames with specified settings.

methods.name: IsPing
methods.description: Creates a matcher for PING frames with specified ID.

methods.name: IsPingAck
methods.description: Creates a matcher for PING ACK frames with specified ID.

methods.name: IsGoAway
methods.description: Creates a matcher for GOAWAY frames with specified last stream ID, error code, and opaque data.

methods.name: IsWindowUpdate
methods.description: Creates a matcher for WINDOW_UPDATE frames with specified delta.
